title: Multicomponent reactions (MCRs) yielding medicinally relevant rings: a recent update and chemical space analysis of the scaffolds
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1447-1489
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06681B, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mukesh Tandi, Vaibhav Sharma, Balasubramanian Gopal, Sandeep Sundriyal
We have reviewed the recently reported multicomponent reactions (MCRs) yielding cyclic frameworks in a single pot from simple building blocks under mild conditions. These MCRs may prove to be useful for drug discovery projects.
